snippet.title: WIDEN - Game Teaser 01 (EN) | Dawn Studios
snippet.description:
WIDEN — A psychological horror indie game by Dawn Studios.
Step into the fractured mind of Mason, an ex-military soldier haunted by past wounds. After being heavily injured during the Iraq War, he finds himself in an eerie, seemingly empty city. But is it really empty?

Wishlist WIDEN on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2759940?utm_source=youtube_teaser_01
